biography: Joakim etched a unique, if brief, entry into the narrative of the Hector Trophée, having made a solitary foray onto the championship greens of this esteemed pair competition. His lone participation, though not extensive, underscored a willingness to engage with the tournament's challenging format.

During his single competitive outing, Joakim confronted the rigorous demands of both the individual and pair formats with diligent effort. However, the ultimate accolades, specifically the coveted Hector Trophée for the triumphant pair or the prestigious individual Victor Trophy, remained uncaptured by him on that occasion.

Following this engagement, Joakim has largely receded from the active competitive sphere of the Hector events and is now regarded as having concluded his pursuit of this particular championship. His absence from the roster for the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026 solidifies this position, marking a quiet yet definitive close to his chapter within the tournament's demanding landscape.
